item.title: Home Assistant HTTPS Certificates with Tailscale, Traefik and CoreDNS
item.description: Secure Home Assistant with HTTPS using Tailscale MagicDNS and a Traefik reverse proxy. Automatic TLS renewal with CoreDNS and Docker Compose.

item.title: Homeassistant Enable MagicDNS and HTTPS Certificates in Tailscale
item.description: Get valid HTTPS certificates for Home Assistant with Tailscale MagicDNS, so local voice control works without port forwarding or a public domain.

item.title: Fortigate: AP-Bridge with a hardware switch
item.description: Configure Fortigate access point bridge SSIDs mapped to isolated VLANs, tagging wireless clients into security zones with CAPWAP management.

item.title: Fortigate: Add a VLAN to a hardware switch
item.description: Create VLANs on a Fortigate hardware switch with a DHCP server and inter-VLAN firewall rules, with 802.1Q trunk ports for segmentation in FortiOS 6.0+.

item.title: Monitor your public IP address with Python
item.description: Monitor your public IP address in Python with OpenDNS lookups. Detect VPN drops and confirm IP masking with a polling loop and alerts.

item.title: Python 3 SSH with Paramiko
item.description: Run remote SSH commands from Python 3 with Paramiko. Connect with a password or key, execute commands and capture stdout and stderr.

item.title: Secure DDNS - Namecheap SSL With DDClient
item.description: Keep Namecheap DNS records updated automatically with DDClient over SSL. Configure dynamic DNS for roaming public IP addresses with encrypted HTTPS protocol.

item.title: How to enable subnet overlapping on a Fortigate
item.description: Enable subnet overlapping on a Fortigate so the same IP range can sit on multiple interfaces. Set allow-subnet-overlap in the FortiOS CLI for HA management IPs.

item.title: Double NAT port forwarding with a Fortigate
item.description: Set up Fortigate VIP port forwarding through a double NAT, routing external traffic via a DMZ IP through nested gateways to reach services like Plex.

item.title: Creating a local DNS server with Pi Hole
item.description: Set up Pi-Hole as a local DNS resolver on Debian for network-wide ad blocking. Configure DHCP integration and custom DNS overrides for a home lab environment.
